All 21 words of 0x1026f1868 were independently operand-decoded. X19 saves original X0. The first vptr+0x270 call precedes BL 0x10157486c; that complete 8-byte getter is LDR S0,[X0,#0x80]; RET. FMOV S1,S0 then FMOV S0,S8 select second and first fields respectively. Each accessor/getter on this explicitly bound path has no S8 write; this conclusion does not rely solely on a general ABI preservation assumption. The epilogue restores D9/D8 and integer frame registers, not S0/S1, after the two output moves.
